questions.question: Name the three transformations and say what each one does.
questions.expected_answer: A translation slides a shape, a reflection flips it over a line, and a rotation turns it about a point. The shape keeps its size and shape in all three.

questions.question: What is a tessellation? Give one shape that tessellates and one that does not.
questions.expected_answer: A tessellation is a pattern that covers a surface with no gaps and no overlaps. Squares tessellate, but regular pentagons and circles do not, because they leave gaps.

questions.question: Mrs Mokoena reflects a right-angled triangle paver across its upright side. What composite shape does she get?
questions.expected_answer: She gets an isosceles triangle. It has a line of symmetry along the upright side, because one half is the mirror image of the other.
